An analyst asked this question about a scanned SEC Form 10-K (December 28, 1968), transcribed from page images:

QUESTION: Analyze the marketable securities

Below are the parts of the report you can choose from, grouped by company. Each company's primary statements are always provided with the answer, so don't choose them.
- xx-Nn: numbered notes to that company's financial statements
- xx-SCH-x: supporting schedules
- xx-AUD: the accountants' / auditors' report; xx-TXT: filing text (cover, items, index, letters)
